tasks.label: Build Creator Tools (debug)
args: $env:PATH = 'C:\Program Files\LLVM\bin;' + $env:PATH; xmake f -y -p windows -a x64 -m debug --target_type=client; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; xmake b creator-tools

tasks.label: Install Creator Tools (debug)
args: $running = Get-Process -Name 'Minecraft.Windows' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($running) { throw 'Close Minecraft before installing a native DLL.' }; $source = '${workspaceFolder}\bin\creator-tools'; $dest = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'levilauncher.exe\versions\LeviLamina - 1.26.51.01\mods\creator-tools'; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $source 'creator-tools.dll'))) { throw 'Debug build is missing creator-tools.dll.' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $source 'creator-tools.dll') -Destination $dest -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $source 'creator-tools.pdb') -Destination $dest -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $source 'manifest.json') -Destination $dest -Force
